notes.title: Unsolved Puzzle Challenge: Beat the Dev at His Own Game
notes.content:
[h1]🚨 The Final Puzzle Is Unsolved[/h1]

So here’s a fun pre-launch challenge for all you puzzle lovers:

I accidentally lost the solution to the hardest level in the game, no joke, and now it's just sitting there, mocking me 😅
It was originally part of the main story, but it turned out so difficult I had to move it to the Bonus section, which normally only unlocks after completing the game.

With the full launch just one week away, I thought: why not turn this into a fun community mystery?

The level is available right now via map import (both in the free demo and Early Access), so anyone can give it a shot.

And yes, this is real, I’ve even mentioned it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2666410/discussions/]somewhere in the forums[/url] before...

[h1]🎁 Rewards for the first person to solve it[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h3]Your name in the game credits![/h3]
[*] [h3]The puzzle will be renamed after you![/h3]
[*] [h3]A small mystery prize![/h3]
[/list]
[h1]🕹️ How to play[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Copy the code below to your clipboard (Double-click it and then Ctrl+C):
    [code]2Tka0xun0utv0a0i0b0c0d0y0f0b0i0bg1aj0ze1ebng0UA0QA0MA0IA0EA0AAWASAOAzcda1la0U0M0M0M0E0M1hy1l0a1ar1G0M1K0MO0MK0M0l0i0s0h1mjz0mhyr0kqzejajare0hC0MU0Ca0llc[/code]
[*] Open [i]Astra Ignota[/i]

[*] Press [b]Play [/b] → [b]New imported map[/b]
[/olist]

[h1]📬 How to submit your solution[/h1]

Send a screenshot of the completed map to: xavi@qojat.com

[h1]🧭 Tips for New Players[/h1]

If you've never played [i]Astra Ignota[/i] before, I recommend starting with the tutorial levels first, as they’ll teach you the basics of symmetry and galaxy growth.

Also, as you progress through the main story, you'll unlock powerful tools like the [b]range finder[/b], which can be extremely helpful for tackling the more complex puzzles. If the challenge level feels overwhelming, it might be worth playing a few chapters of the main campaign first to get your bearings.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Good luck, and may the best galaxy brain win![/h3]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🎉 Full Release: Astra Ignota is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Astra Ignota[/b] is launching out of Early Access!

This minimalist sci-fi puzzle game takes you aboard a sentient spaceship drifting between stars. Your mission: grow symmetrical galaxies from the core outward, solve handcrafted logic puzzles, and piece together a mysterious narrative told through brief story episodes.

[list]
[*] 60 handcrafted levels
[*] Procedural puzzles for infinite play
[*] Hauntingly beautiful soundtrack and illustrations
[*] A mysterious sci-fi story
[*] Fully localized in 7 languages
[/list]

After a year of feedback, improvements, and new content, Astra Ignota is ready for its full release.

[table][tr][td][h3]📅 Mark your calendar — Astra Ignota launches June 5!
🧠 Wishlist it now to be notified!
🕹️ Play the free demo today
⭐ Leave a review after playing, it really helps!
🌌 Share it with friends who love puzzles, sci-fi, or both!
[/h3]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[h2]Thank you to everyone who helped shape the journey![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786525/62fa364453a5833709067e8c77f3584cf7b811f2.png[/img]

Xavi

notes.title: Still Alive!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Wow, it's been more than 2 months since the last update! I am so sorry!

Well, here's what's been going on:

[h2]Development is complete[/h2]

The artists have delivered all remaining illustrations, and the game is now feature-complete. Everything I wanted to include in version 1.0 is in, tested and polished, thanks to your feedback and support.

The final builds are ready. All that’s left is to press the button to transition from Early Access to full release.

So... why the delay?

[h2]Steam issues: negative wishlist count[/h2]

I seem to have run into a weird Steam bug: Astra Ignota currently has [b]a negative number of wishlists[/b].
I'm not kidding, more people have [i]removed[/i] the game from their wishlists than have [i]added[/i] it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786525/ac5a61dfdf7ba98ec4f29f966e1d76a25231dfe1.jpg[/img]

I've contacted Steam Support and they agree this is weird.

Since Steam gives more or less launch visibility depending on a game’s wishlist count, I really want to wait until this is resolved before launching.

[h2]What about marketing in the meantime?[/h2]

I’ve also decided not to promote the game yet. If the fix ends up resetting the wishlist count entirely, any marketing efforts now could be wasted.

So, my hands are tied for the moment. But as soon as this issue is cleared up, I’ll announce a release date and begin promoting the game. I might even come back to ask for your help... 🙂

[h2]Thanks for Your Patience[/h2]

I wanted to be transparent because you're following an Early Access game, and I know that comes with trust.

Again, I’m really sorry for the delay. I’ve worked hard on this project, and some of you have, too, sending bug reports and writing guides. Astra Ignota may not be a AAA title, but it’s an honest one. I want to give it the best chance possible.

[b]Stay Tuned![/b]
Xavi

notes.title: BETA 20: New design!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

[h1]This is a big update![/h1]
[list]
[*] New visual identity, logo, and title screen. [b]Tell me what you think about it![/b]
[*] New user interface, more stylish, and tailored for desktop instead of mobile.
[*] Story has pictures! Well, only a couple for now, but more are coming.
[*] New tile textures, subtly animated. The plain old ones can still be enabled from the options menu.
[*] More mouse controls: Tile lock and Undo can be operated from mouse buttons 4 & 5 (forward and back)
[*] Assorted fixes.
[/list]

[H1]OK, what is going on here?[/h1]
Only good things! I thought the game could use some visual polish so I partnered with an artist and did an overhaul of the user interface.
Do you agree it looks far more professional now?

On top of that, story pages have amazing pictures now, so you will have something to look forward to after finishing each episode.
These are still work in progress, but you get to see a sneak-peek for a few ones.

And I'm still working on some cool graphical shaders so levels always end with a bang.

After that, I'd say we're pretty much ready for launch!
There are more features planned, but these can be delivered later. The game cannot be stuck in Early Access forever!

As usual, thank you very much for your support. And don't forget to report EVERY issue you find!

notes.title: BETA 19: Feedback addressed
notes.content:
[h1]Development Update[/h1]
Hello!

I'm working with a designer on a general revamp of the layout. We are giving the game a far more polished look, adding color, illustrations... it's not going to look like the old Astra Ignota, and that's a good thing. Oh yes, yes it is.

At the same time, I'm spicing up the game tiles so they don't look so flat. Take a look at the end of this message!

While all that is getting ready, I bring you some assorted improvements, based on the feedback I'm receiving:

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The range filler can now be used only with the mouse. Much more comfortable. Just left-click while holding down the right-button.
[*] Removed click mode. Feedback is unanimous in that it requires far too many clicks. Tutorials have been changed accordingly.
[*] One continuous song for each episode instead of constantly changing tracks. This gives each episode its own identity.
[*] Fixes to the space theme: removed one of the music tracks, and some sound and visual effects.
[*] Starting music volume was too loud, so it's been lowered.
[*] Fixes for UHD monitors.
[*] Fixes to translations.
[*] Game assets are now nicely packaged in a single file, instead of spilled all over your hard drive.
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Changes Preview[/h1]

These are some things I'm working on. This is all Work In Progress! No promises!

See you in the next update!

Xavi

notes.title: BETA 18: Content done!
notes.content:
Hello hello!

I bet you didn't expect an update so soon, huh?
Well, get used to it!

BETA 18 has:
[list]
[*] 10 more levels. They are HARD. I mean, they are the last ones, come on! I moved level 50 a bit further up, but it's still there, don't get your hopes up too high...
[*] A complete story, ending at level 60. There are now two story pieces per episode, so if you already completed some episodes, I recommend revisiting them again, because they now have TWO story buttons.
[*] Drag mode improvements: It's easier to use now. It has the same visual cues as Click mode (arrows and red crosses), and the galaxy you first click on never loses focus.
[*] Bugfixes. Again, I don't know who put those bugs there. It wasn't me. Ninjas, probably.
[/list]

The entire story is fully translated into all supported languages, but [b]I would greatly appreciate it[/b] if you could read it and point out any mistakes I made! Thanks! 谢谢! ありがとう! 감사해요! Gracias! дякую! Gràcies!

This is all the content I originally planned for the game! Next update will focus on visual quality... I know Astra Ignota needs it :)
After that, I expect bugfixes, fine tuning and... launch!
We're close, everyone! Tell all your friends to wishlist it!

Thanks so much for sticking with me, I love you all!
Xavi

notes.title: BETA 17: Summer break is over!
notes.content:
Hello!

Summer break is over, it's time for an update!
I believe the game mechanics are maturing quite nicely, thanks to all your feedback.

The next update will be focused on adding more levels and progressing the story, ramping up to finally launching this guy.
A demo version will be available soon, so newcomers can test the game for free. Once the demo is out, expect a price increase :)

Back to the present! This is what you get in this update:

[list]
[*] [b]Unlockable features[/b]: Not everything is available from the start, you get more tools as you progress.
[*] [b]Allow removing tiles[/b]: Just CTRL + click and watch those mistakes go. Don't worry, you need to confirm, and Undo still works.
[*] Initial levels must be played sequentially, to prevent newcomers from missing important tutorials.
[*] Small zen maps are more varied. They tended to be pretty repetitive, specially the triangular ones.
[*] Ukrainian translation added. I really should not be adding so many languages until the story is more mature, but this one allowed me to test non-English and non-CJK fonts. Translation provided by the community, YOU ARE THE BEST!
[*] CTRL + Z also undoes, just like the U key. You asked for it, you know who you are :D
[*] Assorted fixes. Nothing serious. I don't make mistakes. I'm a gifted programmer. Move along.
[/list]

I've got a ton of small things I would like to work on, but I think I should focus on actually RELEASING this thing, and THEN refine it. Am I right?

Tell me what you think on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2666410/discussions/]the forums[/url] or on [url=https://x.com/hashtag/astraignota?src=hashtag_click&f=live]X #astraignota[/url]!

Thanks for reading, and see you next time!

notes.title: Development update July 1st
notes.content:
Hello!

This next update is taking longer than usual so I thought I'd put word out there of what I'm working on.

These are the main things, besides the usual minor fixes.

[h2]A shiny new RANGE INDICATOR[/h2]

Right-click on a core and it shows it's maximum range, this is, how long it can be extended, either SAFELY or UNSAFELY:

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786525/80db1f5919f722d705c0b14090edaf30c677bfe1.jpg[/img][/th]
[th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786525/c0926d4174dbdd0ffab10bee0f88a69b94ae76be.jpg[/img][/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

The safe range shows how far you can currently extend the core without breaking other galaxies.
The unsafe range shows the maximum extension, trampling over all other galaxies. Tiles that require breaking other galaxies are shown in red.

[h2]The RANGE FILLER[/h2]

When showing the range, press a key to fill it safely. Press again to fill unsafely.
Pretty destructive, but don't worry, the UNDO key is still working.

With this option, clearing smaller levels is an absolute breeze! And the big ones can be completed in weeks instead of months! :D

[h2]TUTORIALS[/h2]

Unfortunately the range indicator can be a bit hard to grasp at first, so it needs a tutorial, and while doing tutorials, why not do them properly for all other features?

I noticed the essential mechanics of the game are unclear to some players, so let's help them a bit:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786525/76f1d5a87aeb859e53ea7bf1c76dbb632a355f33.jpg[/img]

Don't worry, you can always skip the tutorials or summon them later :)

[h2]UNLOCKABLE FEATURES[/h2]

So many features are going to be daunting, so let's space them a bit, and allow players to grasp the basic concepts before jumping to the more advanced ones.

Each finished episode unlocks a new feature (drag mode, range indicator, range filler, the editor...), giving the game more feeling of progression, which is nice.

[h2]See you next time![/h2]

So this is what I'm currently working on! I hope you like it!

Don't forget to tell your friends about the game and write positive reviews! :P

notes.title: BETA 14: Difficulty adjusted!
notes.content:
[h2]Summary[/h2]

Along with a price tag, this update brings you:

[list]
[*] Sorted levels by difficulty.
[*] Added Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Catalan translations.
[*] Added a language selection menu.
[*] Added windowed mode.
[*] Slightly lower CPU usage.
[*] Fix crash when running for a long time.
[*] Allow sending a debug report when a crash is detected.
[*] Assorted tweaks.
[/list]

[h2]How is difficulty measured?[/h2]

Every time a level is completed, the time it took to finish is sent to a spreadsheet of mine, After analyzing more than 7000 games, I can plot the average completion time for each level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786525/e7a73ea634b85855b1feee646596dd99423de5a2.png[/img]

It's not nice, it looks like a rollercoaster. More precisely, there's a spike in level 13 which might explain why so few people make it past episode 2.

Therefore, I reordered the levels so they now look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786525/361064658206f826e5dbb39812e26549ef6b301c.png[/img]

I hope this makes the game much more enjoyable!

This is all thanks to the games you've been playing so far. Thank you very much!

[h2]Languages![/h2]

Spent some dollars and got the game translated to Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Catalan.
OK, the last two I did myself. Apologies for any mistakes.

If you want to see more languages, send me a message!

[h2]And more[/h2]

You can now play in windowed mode, so you can answer your emails while you think of galaxies.

CPU usage should be slightly lower, so fans might not need to kick in and you can enjoy a quieter evening.

Game was shutting down without warning after about 30 minutes, but not anymore.
Furthermore, if it happens again, it will allow you to send me a bug report and attach the execution log.

And a few more tweaks, new level complete sound, new Steam achievement badges, ...

This is it for today! Read you in the forums, and if not, see you in the next update!

Xavi
